Name: Fetching Letters Quest
Offer: So you made it to the port of Athens. Go through the city gate and report to the Ares Warrior Alliance Master. Tell him the Docker sent you.
Done: The Docker sent you? Good. Athens can always use another captain.

Name: Collect Crab Pincers
Offer: Crabs in Athens are very popular these days. Go and collect 8 Crab Pincers. A rich merchant will offer high price for them.
Done: Eight Crab Pincers. The merchant will be pleased.

Name: Task of Hides
Offer: Mahmoud of Alexander now needs some Red Foxes' hide to make battle uniform for Battle Alliance. You should collect a piece of Worn Hide in the suburb and bring it to me.
Done: This hide will do nicely. Here is your reward.

Name: Find Pilose Antler
Offer: A soldier of Battle Alliance was injured during a task. Now we need to help them to find a Pilose Antler to cure him. There are many reindeers in the suburb. They must have Pilose Antlers.
Done: A Pilose Antler. The soldier will recover now.

Name: Kill Depressed Poet
Offer: There is a Depressed Poet in the suburb. He frequently attacks passersby and many people have been attacked by him. Now Battle Alliance has received a task to destroy him. He is very strong, so you should bring Healing Potion.
Done: The road through the suburb is safe again. Well fought.

Name: Mission of abstracting Pig Irons
Offer: Due to the low value of raw materials, ores can only function when semi-manufactured metal is extracted from them and alloyed. Please try to extract 10 pieces of pig iron and give them to me.
Done: Twenty pieces of Pig Iron, just what the guild needed.

Name: Purchase Bananas
Offer: The food workshop needs Bananas in quantities. It would buy 20 baskets at the price of 70 silver coins per basket.
Done: Twenty baskets of Bananas at 70 silver coins per basket, as agreed.
